fn solve(n: Int, k: Int, L: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (k >= 1)
  requires (n <= (2 * k))
  requires (len(L) == n)
  requires forall i in 0..(len(L) - 1): (L[i] <= L[(i + 1)])
  requires forall i in 0..len(L): (L[i] >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, []) == 0)
{
  0
}
